key_insights: AP Computer Science A teaches Java programming fundamentals (loops, conditionals, object-oriented programming, arrays)
AP Computer Science Principles instead focuses on internet infrastructure, networking, and how data moves between servers and storage
Passion projects (machine learning, apps, websites) can extend a CS applicant's profile beyond the AP curriculum
Suggests building apps with a social-impact angle, e.g. a recyclable-object detector or a skin-condition classifier, to showcase interest
Teaching computer science to others (younger students, senior citizens) is framed as a way to demonstrate initiative around the 'digital divide'
Academic research and summer programs are presented as additional avenues beyond AP coursework for building a CS profile
notable_or_distinctive: Offers concrete example app ideas (recyclable-object detector, skin-cancer-detection app) as tangible ways to demonstrate CS interest beyond AP classes.
reliability_notes: Very short, generic promotional content with no citation of admissions data or named officers; standard, broadly-applicable advice rather than specific insight.
